values.meaning: second shot on-hit physical damage (percent AD)
values.quote: {{as|50% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}, increased to {{as|100% AD}} against {{tip|minions}}

values.meaning: bonus magic damage dealt when a target reaches 3 stacks of Dirty Fighting
shield amount gained when the 3-stack bonus damage is dealt to a champion
values.binNote: Wiki gives its own by-level formula (40+(240/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))) which does not exactly match the bin's AkshanPassive#TotalShieldAmount flat byLevel array (e.g. level 2: wiki 50.16 vs bin 54.12); both start at 40 and end at 280 but diverge at intermediate levels. Reporting the wiki's stated number per its own quoted formula.

values.meaning: duration a stack of Dirty Fighting persists before expiring
values.quote: to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications
values.binNote: Wiki text states the stack lasts 5 seconds, but the bin's AkshanPassive.DebuffDuration is 4.5.

values.meaning: number of stacks required to trigger the bonus damage/shield
static cooldown before the shield can be granted again, starting when the previous shield is destroyed or expires

mechanics.claim: The second shot applies on-hit effects, triggers on-attack effects, and is affected by critical strike modifiers, and crits independently from the first shot.
mechanics.quote: The additional shot applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

mechanics.claim: The first shot deals basic attack damage while the second shot's extra damage is proc damage, meaning they interact differently with modifiers that distinguish basic vs proc damage.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|basic damage}} for the second shot and {{tip|proc damage}} for the bonus damage.

mechanics.claim: The second shot starts the attack windup cooldown (basic attack reset) when it is fired, not when the first shot is fired.
mechanics.quote: Starts the attack windup's cooldown after it is used, rather than when the first shot is.

mechanics.claim: Stacks of Dirty Fighting are applied by basic attacks (on-hit) and ability hits, and refresh their duration on each new application rather than stacking duration independently.
mechanics.quote: '''Akshan's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability}} hits apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Dirty Fighting'' to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.

mechanics.claim: Reaching the third stack consumes all stacks at once to deal the bonus magic damage; the shield is only granted if the target hit was a champion.
mechanics.quote: The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal them {{as|{{pp|15;40;80;150|1;6;11;16}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}; if the target is a {{tip|champion}}, '''Akshan''' will also gain a {{pplevel|40+(240/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} {{as|(+ 35% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds.

mechanics.claim: This ability's damage is calculated based on Akshan's current stats at the moment it lands and changes dynamically (not locked in on cast).
mechanics.quote: This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.
